description: Source code for the abstract class 'Receiver' in Apache Spark Streaming, defining the interface and core methods for data receivers running on worker nodes, including data storage, error handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface and core functionalities for data receivers in Spark Streaming, including methods for starting, stopping, storing data, error reporting, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Method called when the receiver starts; initializes resources for data reception.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Method called when the receiver stops; cleans up resources.

methods.name: preferredLocation
methods.description: Optional method to specify preferred hostname for the receiver.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Overloaded methods to store data items, buffers, iterators, or bytes into Spark's memory.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports errors encountered during data reception.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Schedules a receiver restart with optional error and delay parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the receiver, optionally with an error.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the receiver has started.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the receiver has been marked for stopping.

methods.name: streamId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the receiver's input stream.
